subject: Geometry
question_text: The circle with centre $O$ has chord $AB$. If $\angle AOB = 80^\circ$, find the inscribed angle $\angle ACB$ subtended by the same arc $AB$.
explanation: The inscribed angle is half the central angle standing on the same arc: $\angle ACB = 80^\circ \div 2 = 40^\circ$.

common_mistakes.why: Confused central angle with inscribed angle.

subject: Geometry
question_text: Two parallel lines $l$ and $m$ are cut by a transversal. If one corresponding angle is $65^\circ$, find the vertically opposite angle.
explanation: Vertically opposite angles are always equal, so the angle is also $65^\circ$. Corresponding angles being equal confirms the lines are parallel.

subject: Geometry
question_text: In right-angled triangle $ABC$ with $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 4\text{ cm}$ and $BC = 3\text{ cm}$. Find $x = \angle A$.
explanation: Opposite $\angle A$ is $BC = 3$, adjacent is $AB = 4$, so $\tan x = 3/4$ and $x = \tan^{-1}(3/4) \approx 36.87^\circ$.

subject: Geometry
question_text: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides $3, 4, 5$ and $6, 8, x$. Find $x$.

common_mistakes.why: Copied the matching side instead of scaling the third side.
